title: How a Godly Man Kills the Guy Only His Phone Sees
caption:
You pray out loud at small group at 7. By 11 you've got something open you'd never explain to that same room. Both of those are you. Stop calling the second one a phase.

Hidden sin doesn't get weaker with time, it just gets quieter, and quiet isn't the same as gone. Confessed sin is the only kind that starts to die. Pick one man this week, not the whole group text, and tell him the real version, not the one that sounds fine out loud.

Then move the phone. You've prayed about it every time and it was still six inches away at 11 PM. A godly man doesn't out-will a lit screen in a dark room. He removes the room.

Confess your sins to one another and pray for each other, so that you may be healed (James 5:16).

One guy, every room. That's the whole assignment.
